capabilities: Adds a hover menu to the Files row holding the file explorer's actions
Hides the explorer's own button row once the menu button is in place
Shows the tab close button only while hovering a tab
Copies [[Note name]] links to the clipboard from a tab button
Fades and scrolls long tab titles on hover
disambiguation: Not a theme settings panel; it adds a hover menu to the file explorer and changes editor tab buttons for the Contemporary theme.
extras: Desktop only. Uses a few non-public Obsidian internals (leaf.tabHeaderEl, leaf.loadIfDeferred, the explorer's .nav-buttons-container), all guarded so a change falls back to the normal explorer buttons. No build step: main.js, styles.css and manifest.json are loaded directly.
intentEvidence: Adds a "..." button to the Files row in the left sidebar (shown on hover or keyboard focus).
problem: The file explorer's button row takes up sidebar space, and editor tabs always show close buttons and truncated titles that clutter the tab bar.

relations.evidence: Companion plugin for the Contemporary theme (.obsidian/themes/Contemporary).

summary: Companion plugin for the Contemporary theme that puts the file explorer's actions in a hover menu on the Files row and trims editor tab buttons.
